## Review protocol

Before public intake is enabled, keep the result as `pending_public_intake`. Once an owner activates public intake, the maintainer records `acknowledged`, `needs-info`, `accepted-for-design`, `declined`, or `blocked` within the documented activation target. No security or conduct report belongs here.
